contract.validation: Exact migration-backed OpenAPI/runtime projection; signed request location and pagination binding; source-defined resource type, description, urgency and date bounds; exact row count/continuation; unique IDs; requested_by DESC, id DESC ordering; continuation ends at offset 10,000; requester, fulfiller and private receipt fields are excluded.
contract.authorization: Exact operating_pilot:fulfill location grant and signed tenant context are unchanged; the route performs a bounded read only.

verification.ruff_default: passed on changed source and tests
verification.fixture_update: Updated the prior fulfillment route fixture with the complete page metadata required by the strict response contract.

rollback: Revert the Gateway response model/route, focused tests, fixture update, and refactor progress/evidence records; no database rollback is needed.
